'''Ross''' was a [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] retailer on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The company operated several stores around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The storefront showed the company's name in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] symbols. The façade was decorated with a neon sign which read "hot". Sometimes, the shops would sell their goods at a lower price than usual, whereupon a neon "sale" sign would be put up in order to attract customers.<ref name="LL"/> At least one Ross store featured an additional neon sign above the "sale" sign, depicting a [[Human/Legends|human]]([[Humanoid/Legends|oid]]) person clad in a dress or coat, suggesting that Ross was a [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] store.<ref name="Zillo Beast Strikes Back"/>

==Behind the scenes==
Ross was created for the animated television show ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="LL"/> The name is never spoken in the series, and the establishment is only identifiable through the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] signage.
